notes.title: Release date of the game demo
notes.content:
The demo version will be released on May 27 for free access. 

Hello, warm up your computers because in a week you will be able to try playing Maiden for free. A demo version will be available for everyone, which will include the first three rooms that will allow you to fully experience the essence of the game, namely:
[olist]
 Check the work of potions.
 Run from ??????.
 Stun yourself.
 Die.
 Shove ?????? into a wall or other object. 
 Find out if your PC is a surfboard. 
There's actually a lot more, but I won't describe it, there's a whole set of emotions that this game will cause you.
[/olist]

By the way, there should be no problems with performance, the game runs on GTX 1660 at 120+ frames per second.

And most likely, this demo version will be available after the release of the main game, which will take place on June 24! (with a nice little bonus)
Those who don't want to buy the premium version will be able to run in the first three rooms for free. 
But it may happen that I will disable the demo version.

Also, if you have something to say (actually, I'm the one who wants to talk to someone), then go to the Discord group (there's an icon at the bottom), or create or post in the game's community threads.

Well, I'm waiting for you.

Now in the final battle, you need to find six damage potions.

notes.title: When will the game be released and why?
notes.content:
I'm not going to drag this out and tell you right away that the game's release date is June 24, 2025.
You may say: Igor, but we've seen a lot of YouTube videos about the game, it's ready, why don't you release it? We still have to wait three months, oh no, we are so tired. 
Some developers lie that they need more time to polish the game.
I'm not lying and here's why:
[olist]
 First of all, three months will be enough for me to finish the game based on the feedback of the let'splays from the affiliate program, in which you can also participate.
 Secondly, I need to recruit an audience before releasing the game.
[/olist]
So:

 Everyone wins
 In early summer, there will be a Stam game festival where you can play the demo version of the game for free.
 Maybe I'll start my own philosophical blog.

notes.title: Collaboration with bloggers, streamers, and let'splays.
notes.content:
If you are one of these people and want new content, this is the place to go.
Our deal with you will be 100% profitable, honestly. I never cheat people.
And so we can get to the point.
What do you need?
[olist]
 You must have a channel with 1000+ subscribers where you regularly shoot something.
 You must not cheat people.
 I give you access to the game without restrictions and you shoot a video or make a stream.
[/olist]
Benefit for the parties:

 You have a new hype content that flies like hotcakes. yum
 I have feedback from you and your viewers in the comments

The developer is no fool and here's why:
I already had a lot of experience with my two previous games and you won't believe it, but I got more video bloggers than people who bought my game. 
Why is that?
Because they cheat, this is a simple life hack - you write to me on mail saying that you are the owner of a channel for 200 thousand people and will be happy to play my game. But in reality, he's some leftist guy who easily got the game for 0.
So how do you apply for my affiliate program?

 You have to write me an email to stellaris.maindistrict@gmail.com
 The email address you use must be identical to the one you use on your YouTube channel
 If you are from another platform, we will [strike]work something out[/strike]. 
 You can write anything in the letter, for example: Package of gingerbread, I'm a blogger, give me the key.
 I'll give you the key, but if there is no video, I'll file a lawsuit. 
 Also, you should not be connected with the aggressor country in any way.
